cases.title: A pipe end 90 mm outside pit P8's opening is caught and moved onto the inside wall; a pipe end 110 mm outside stays a free end (the 100 mm reach, card D02)
cases.plan_item: UX-PIT-02 pit catch, outline plus 100 mm, the boundary pair (daily card D02; with N19 the whole card)
cases.expected: Running snaps off (OSMODE 0 through v3, put back at the end). New pit P8 at 150000,-80000 (cover 19.000, three Esc). Near pipe from 160225,-79850 to 150315,-79850 (end 90 mm outside the 450 mm opening, inverts 18.000 / 17.950): CE says 'Pipe end moved to the inside wall of P8 (was 90 mm short of the wall).' and 'Flow: Open end -> P8', and the pipe box starts at x 150225 within 1 mm. Far pipe from 160335,-80150 to 150335,-80150 (end 110 mm outside): no wall move, 'Flow: Open end -> Open end', the pipe box starts at x 150335 within 1 mm. Exactly two 'Flow: ' lines (no other pit named) and three 'End is free' lines.
cases.why_not_unit: The catch uses the real pit block's outline and the live CD landing in the drawing.
not_automated: The pit's size is not set by the robot (the Pit tab cannot be selected); it is the remembered 450 x 450 (recorded). A different size makes the derived numbers fail, never pass.
Running snaps are off in this case on purpose (the rule, not the snap, is under test); with Tim's snaps on, a click near the wall line can be pulled onto it.
